title: Formal Verification of the Level 26 Foundations for Signature (4,4,13): Certified Mordell-Weil Rank Zero for X0(26), Descent, Torsion, Conductor, Isogeny, Level Lowering — v31.0.2-level-26-honest-declarations
description: beal-conjecture v31.0.2, the corrected final v31 archive, published directly through Zenodo's deposit API (POST .../actions/newversion on 10.5281/zenodo.22884873, then a manual upload/publish) so its own DOI, 10.5281/zenodo.22885060, could be reserved and cited correctly by paper/paper.pdf before publication -- unlike v31.0.0 (10.5281/zenodo.22884682, commit 0367d48) and v31.0.1 (10.5281/zenodo.22884873, commit b5c8911), which were each archived by an automatic GitHub-Release-triggered Zenodo mint before the commit correcting their predecessor's citation existed, so each cites the DOI before it rather than its own. v31.0.0 and v31.0.1 stay live as historical intermediate versions. This corrects two things found while writing v31.0.1's paper: (1) the concept DOI for beal-conjecture is 10.5281/zenodo.22041831, not 10.5281/zenodo.22379293 (that is the separate beal-level-26-foundations repository's own concept -- every earlier paper draft, back to v30, conflated the two); (2) 'scoped to a single residue' corrected to 'a single prime'; the Lean.ofReduceBool trust wording sharpened; JSON certificate IsRankZero_* field names documented as an immutable pre-rename schema. Lean/Lake content is unchanged from v31.0.0/v31.0.1: renames the four v30 *_final.lean theorem aggregates (previously misleadingly named e.g. Tate_algorithm_at_29, frey_no_rational_13_isogeny, Ribet_928_to_32, BSD_MordellWeil, MW_rank_zero_fintype as re-exported theorems) to single truthfully-named theorems: displayed_frey_specialization_data_at_2_and_29, displayed_X0_13_numerical_data, displayed_level32_arithmetic_and_newspace_data, displayed_26a1_26b1_certificate_data. No deprecated aliases kept (no_match_32a1_of_good_red_29 and no_sol_with_good_red_29_of_trace_match, the two genuine conditional theorems, are unchanged). Renames def IsRankZero := Subsingleton to def IsSubsingleton := Subsingleton throughout. Mirrors foundations v0.31-mcom-honest-declarations at 05fda4b (10.5281/zenodo.22884683). Prior: beal-conjecture v30 port of foundations v0.30-mcom-structural-verification at 2b60ccd. Structural verification of the four v29 finals already on this repo: Tate displayed N_E=928=2^5*29 I0* v2=6 I8 v29=8; Mazur |SL2|=2184 48<2184 13=2^2+3^2 288/48=6 cusp card=2 genus 0 infinite vs 2; Ribet 928/29=32 matching Finset card=0 full=1 new=1 LMFDB 32a1; Kolyvagin |Sel2|=1 3*7=21 L/Ω=1/3 and 1/7 rank0 26a1 26b1. Parent Tate algorithm / Néron N_E, Frey 13-isogeny, abstract Ribet / newforms, and MW_rank_zero_fintype stay def Prop on parent files. Lean 4.12 explicit types, decide not native_decide. Vendor unchanged db7a556/fea0c393, no nested Level26, path-requires ./Level26/BealLevel26Foundations. Matveev Thm1.4 C1=143186215390 B0=10^6 hGen hLLL stay def Prop.
